Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NEIGRIHMS Scientist-B (Non-Medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 01 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Scientist-B (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a 1st class Master's degree in Microbiology or a 2nd class M.Sc. + Ph.D degree in Microbiology from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Scientist-B (Non-Medical) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this post is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Scientist-B (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 56,000/- per month, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Scientist-B (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Scientist-B (Non-Medical) position in NEIGRIHMS.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the NEIGRIHMS Scientist-B (Non-Medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve Document Verification followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the NEIGRIHMS located?
faq.answer: NEIGRIHMS is located in Shillong, Meghalaya, with the pincode 793018.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Scientist-B (Non-Medical) position is a contractual job.
